Should the shoulders as well as the feet be touching ??? Please include reference from Hadith & Fiqh. Is there iany difference of opnion among the Madahib? 2526 views Q. I work in Saudi Arabia and go back home after every one year. I belong to Nainital district of U.P. (Now Uttarakhand) which is very near to Bareilly and the Barelwi Maslak is rampant in that area. "Mazar parasti" and Urs, etc., are the foremost part of their Islam and Aqeeda. In my village there are only two mosques and the Imams leading the prayers are staunch Barelwi. I had a discussion with one of these Imams of our moque, he has the belief that to ask for help (Mannat) with the dead (Mazar) is as good as praying God. Since then, I stopped praying with him. I offer all my five prayers in my home during my vacation of one month or so. Secondly, my wife is very punctual in prayers and other Shariah matters. She also joins my prayers which I lead in my house. Please enlighten me on;(1)if, under the circumstances explained above, my prayers in my home are correct, (2) prayers led by me and joined by my wife are correct. or I should go the mosque and pray behing the same Imam as explained above. I shall highly appreciate your immediate reply on the above e-mail address. Best regards 2929 views Q. answer: Prayers & Duties >> Salah (Prayer) Question ID: 35702 Country: India Title: Can read namaz with in-shirt? Question: Please let me know if I can read namaz with in-shirt? I am a business man and my dress is in-shirt and pant. I have come to know from some people that reading namaz with in-shirt is not correct. Please let me know the correct answer. Answer ID: 35702 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 1908/1908/M=1432) It is makrooh (undesirable) to offer salah by inserting shirt in pant. You should offer salah without in-shirt. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
